The present petition has been filed seeking quashing of case FIR No. 218/2020 dated 16.12.2022 registered at EOW, New Delhi under Section 406/420/120B of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 for the following prayere:
"issue an appropriate Writ or any other similar order/direction in the nature of certiorari setting aside and quashing of FIR No. 218/2020 dated 16.12.2022 registered at EOW, New Delhi alleging commission of offence by the Petitioners under Section 406, 420 and 120B of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and the proceedings arising therefrom;"

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that a FIR on the identical facts was lodged bearing FIR No. 253/2019 at PSCC B-I under Section 406/420/120B IPC by Mr. Ashok Sachdeva who is the father of respondent Nos. 3, 5, 7 and 9.

sentences.text: 1 Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the Chennai Police after investigation filed the closure report in that case and the protest petition was filed by the petitioner.
Issue notice.
Learned counsel on behalf of respondent Nos. 1 and 2 accepts notice.
Mr. Maninder Singh, Learned Senior counsel on behalf of respondent Nos. 3, 5, 7 and 9 accepts notice.

Learned counsel on behalf of respondent Nos. 3, 5, 7 and 9 submits that simply because in the complaint filed by Mr. Ashok Sachdeva the closure report has been filed it does not deprive the present respondents to pursue their proceedings.
Let respondent No. 4, 6, 8 and 10 be served through all permissible modes.
Additional Standing Counsel states that the investigation is in progress.
Let status report be filed.
Respondent No. 3, 5, 7 and 9 are also directed to file the reply with an advance copy to the other party.
The remaining respondents may also file the reply.
This is an application for the stay of the proceedings.
Issue notice.
Learned counsel for respondent Nos. 3, 5, 7 and 9 accepts notice.
Learned counsel for respondent Nos. 1 and 2 also accepts notice.
Issue notice to remaining respondents through all permissible modes on PF to be filed by the petitioners.
DINESH KUMAR SHARMA, J APRIL 21, 2023/AR
